name: software-engineering-project
description: ClearLens — image de-hazing platform. Runs the ML inference service, the Fastify API and the Next.js client together in development.

scripts.setup: npm install && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client && python -m venv ML\inference_service\.venv && ML\inference_service\.venv\Scripts\python.exe -m pip install torch --index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cpu && ML\inference_service\.venv\Scripts\python.exe -m pip install -r ML\inference_service\requirements.txt
